title: Identity proofing, key-control acceptance protocol and operator entrust matrix
creator: Asha Menon
description: This ticket defines the product requirements, testable acceptance criteria, and final sign-off steps for identity proofing and key-control behaviors in Private/VPC deployments. The emphasis is on creating an auditable operator entrust protocol: who may perform key import/rotation/escrow, SAML assertions expected for operator sessions, RBAC least-privilege roles for key operations, HSM quorum requirements, and the evidence package required for enterprise acceptance. This is a product-facing PRD addendum that clarifies ambiguous scope from the secure-onboarding PRs and standardizes the acceptance artifacts consumed by Security, Sales, and Customer Engineering for go/no-go decisions.
requirements: SSO/SAML: support enforcing IdP-signed SAML assertions with 'operator' role binding and assertion replay detection (audience, inResponseTo, NotOnOrAfter checks)
RBAC: a new 'key_admin' granular role that permits key import/export/rotation but denies non-key infrastructure changes; role mappings must be configurable via SCIM or console

Audit logging: every key-related action (import, export attempt, rotation, escrow, operator impersonation) must emit an immutable audit record with request_id, subject_id, action, object_id, pre/post state hashes, and KMS request context
KMS/HSM: support for multi-participant HSM quorum for on-prem HSMs (N-of-M policy) and customer-managed HSM provider SSH-style attestation outputs for rotation events
Evidence package: documented integration tests, binary artifacts, and signed logs for a sample customer on-boarding demonstrating end-to-end SSO->RBAC->KMS flows
Operator approval flow: two-step approval for destructive key actions with temporal constraints (max approval TTL), logged approver IDs and reason
Upgrade/rollback safety: private deploy upgrade sequence must preserve key access semantics and validate HSM membership after any operator-induced topology change
scope_changes: Original PRD required 'operator audit logs' without defining immutability; this ticket elevates immutability and signed log artifacts as required for acceptance
Added requirement for explicit SAML replay protection and audience checks following a security review request
Clarified that RBAC mappings must be exportable via API/SCIM; previously console-only mappings were proposed
Excluded cross-tenant key escrow delegation (will be tracked in separate PM-XXXXX surgery ticket)
acceptance_criteria: End-to-end test: a customer SAML IdP flow authenticates an operator, maps to 'key_admin' role, performs a key rotation; rotation is committed only after quorum attestation and recorded in the immutable audit store
Log integrity: audit records for key operations are cryptographically signed (or have tamper-evident append-only metadata) and verified by a supplied verification script
RBAC enforcement: users without 'key_admin' cannot call KMS key endpoints (import/export/rotate); test vectors prove DENY responses and proper error codes
SAML validation: automated tests exercise NotOnOrAfter, audience, and inResponseTo checks and simulate replay to confirm rejection
HSM quorum: simulate an N-of-M rotation with missing participant and confirm rotation fails; then restore participants and confirm rotation succeeds and attestation artifacts validate
Operator approval: destructive key deletion requires two distinct approvers; audit shows approver IDs, timestamps, and reason strings
Upgrade safety: run upgrade test harness on a private deploy cluster and demonstrate no lost key access and HSM membership consistency post-upgrade
Evidence bundle: create a Confluence acceptance page with links to the test runs, signed logs, PRs, runbooks, and a short recorded demo (max 10 minutes)
signoff_checklist: Engineering: implementation PRs merged and release branch cut (link to PRs in links)
Security: threat model updated and sign-off from Security Review board with explicit comments addressed
Compliance: retention policy validated for audit logs (signed acceptance from Compliance)
Customer Engineering: performed two on-prem/airgap dry-run onboards and uploaded signed evidence bundles
SRE/Operations: runbook for operator key actions reviewed and included in private-deploy operator guide
Legal: export control review for key export flows completed (if applicable)
Sales/Customer Success: acceptance criteria and required artifacts communicated to enterprise customers as part of onboarding checklist
Final PM sign-off: PM verifies evidence bundle and marks ticket Done
dependencies: ENG-21100 (RBAC policy API: export/import via SCIM)
ENG-21984 (HSM attestation adapter for rotated keys)
notes: This ticket consolidates operator/key acceptance criteria across multiple customer requests to reduce onboarding variance.
We expect the first enterprise customers using this flow to be those with 'high' regulatory requirements (finance, healthcare).
If HSM vendor attestation formats vary, Engineering will supply an adapter shim and record the canonical verification steps in the runbook.
